description.zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用[ListClusters](~~87116~~)获取集群ID。
description.en:
The ID of the cluster.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.

description.zh:
命令ID。

您可以通过调用[ListCommands](~~87388~~)获取命令ID。
description.en:
The ID of the command.

You can call the [ListCommands](~~87388~~) operation to query the command ID.

description.zh: 执行命令的目标节点信息列表。
description.en: The information of nodes on which the command is run.

description.zh:
第N个执行命令的目标节点实例ID。
>用于限定执行范围，不指定则默认在集群所有节点上执行。
description.en:
The ID of the node on which the command is run.

>  The Instance.N.Id parameter specifies the node on which the command is run. If it is not specified, the command is run on all nodes of the cluster.

description.zh:
需要查询的命令的运行状态。取值范围：
- Finished：已结束
- Running：运行中
- Failed：运行失败
- Stopped：已停止
description.en:
The status of the command that you want to query. Valid values:

*   Finished
*   Running
*   Failed
*   Stopped

description.zh:
当前页码。

起始值：1

默认值：1
description.en:
The number of the page to return.

Page numbers start from 1.

Default value: 1

description.zh:
每页显示的行数。取值范围：1~50

默认值：10
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50.

Default value: 10
